newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France sees 802 mln Ffr H1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Air France sees 802 mln Ffr H1 profit.

text.p: Air France estimated on Tuesday that it would earn a net profit of 802 million francs in the six months to September 30, compared to a loss of 335 million francs in the previous period.
The year-earlier result included profits of 295 million francs and a provision of 630 million francs for restructuring costs .
The company said its turnover was up nearly five percent to 21.3 billion francs due to a 14.8 percent increase in passenger traffic and a 6.7 percent rise in freight .
Operating profit rose nearly 30 percent to 1.1 billion francs compared to 849 million in the year-earlier period. The pretax, pre-exceptional result tripled to 660 million francs from 221 million.
The company said these results were obtained despite a rise in spending on fuel of nearly 500 million francs for the period.
Air France is ahead by "a little more than 250 million francs of its budget" at half time, the company said.
The first half is traditionally the better one, for seasonal reasons and should not be used to extrapolate for the full year, it added.

Its debt stood at 12.9 billion francs at September 30, versus 19.2 billion at March 31, 1996. The repayment of 6.3 billion significantly exceeded the last tranche of its state recapitalisation paid in September, it said.
The last payment of five billion francs was part of a total 20 billion injection for debt payment, agreed with the European Commission.
